content.value_statement: PRDs often mix goals, code, and implementation details in ways that confuse coding agents. This skill converts them into clear XML app specifications for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Converts PRD implementation details into declarative app specification sections.
Extracts project metadata, technology stack, data models, features, APIs, steps, and success criteria.
Maps Pydantic models, tests, CLI examples, and code snippets into prose requirements.
Provides a validation checklist for well-formed XML and measurable criteria.
Supports product-focused and system-focused app specification styles.
limitations: Requires a readable PRD with enough project context.
May ask for clarification when critical requirements are ambiguous.
Does not execute validation tools or run the generated specification.
Cannot guarantee completeness when source PRDs omit features, constraints, or tests.

use_cases.title: Prepare Agent Build Specs
use_cases.description: Turn an engineering PRD into a structured app specification before assigning implementation to a coding agent.

use_cases.title: Translate Product Requirements
use_cases.description: Convert product goals, user flows, and acceptance criteria into an agent-ready specification.

use_cases.title: Normalize Technical Documents
use_cases.description: Create consistent XML requirements from PRDs that include schemas, tests, APIs, and implementation notes.

prompt_templates.title: Convert a Basic PRD
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert `PRD.md` into an app specification. Use the default output path.

prompt_templates.title: Choose an Output Path
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate conversion with a known destination.
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert `docs/product-prd.md` into an app specification. Write it to `prompts/app_spec.txt` and summarize missing sections.

prompt_templates.title: Focus on System Constraints
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced conversion for data or backend systems.
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert `PRD.md` into a system-focused app specification. Preserve edge cases, data constraints, APIs, and measurable success criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Validate and Refine
prompt_templates.prompt: Transform `PRD.md` into an agent-ready app specification. Validate section completeness, refine weak sections, and report unresolved product questions.

output_examples.input: A FastAPI PRD with Pydantic models, endpoint descriptions, test assertions, and an epic plan.
output: An app specification with overview, technology stack, feature groups, schema notes, API summaries, implementation steps, and success criteria.
A transformation summary listing extracted models, feature groups, implementation phases, and missing context.

output_examples.input: A product PRD for a dashboard with user flows, UI states, and integration notes.
output_examples.output: A product-focused specification that describes user journeys, interface requirements, integration behavior, acceptance criteria, and validation notes.

output_examples.input: A sparse PRD with goals, a partial tech stack, and unclear success criteria.
output_examples.output: A partial app specification with inferred sections, explicit assumptions, and clarification questions for missing requirements.

best_practices: Provide the PRD file path and a preferred output path before starting.
Keep business goals, constraints, and acceptance criteria in the source PRD.
Review the generated specification for missing domain rules before sending it to a coding agent.
anti_patterns: Do not use a vague PRD that only lists feature names.
Do not keep implementation code when the goal is agent-ready requirements.
Do not skip review of generated steps, constraints, and success criteria.

faq.question: What input does this skill need?
faq.answer: It needs a PRD with project goals, technical context, requirements, and any useful implementation details.

faq.question: What does the skill produce?
faq.answer: It produces an XML app specification with project overview, technology stack, features, schemas, APIs, steps, and success criteria.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The output is designed for AI coding agents, including Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does this skill write application code?
faq.answer: No. It transforms requirements documents into specifications that guide later implementation.

faq.question: How does it handle missing PRD sections?
faq.answer: It derives what it can from available context and asks for clarification on critical gaps.

faq.question: Is it better for product apps or backend systems?
faq.answer: It supports both. The workflow chooses product-focused or system-focused structure from the PRD content.
